about.title: About Sea Radar
about.intro: Sea Radar (Southeast Asia Frontier Information Radar) is an open-source, long-term maintainable information aggregation project.
about.missionDesc: Continuously monitor political, economic, technological, social, and cultural developments in Southeast Asia. Filter out noise through curation, build a searchable local historical database, and finally present valuable content to the public through our publishing site.
about.teamMembers: This project is co-maintained by kivithink-pop and HU.
